scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @researchchain/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api scripts && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @researchchain/web typecheck && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api scripts
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/export-api.py && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/api.ts && prettier --write packages/contracts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.provider:login: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider login
scripts.provider:status: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider status
scripts.provider:accounts: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider accounts
scripts.provider:select: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider select
scripts.provider:logout: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider logout
scripts.provider:models: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider models
scripts.provider:verify: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.provider verify
scripts.db:backup: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.backup create
scripts.db:restore: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.backup restore
scripts.db:keygen: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.backup keygen
scripts.db:seal: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.backup seal
scripts.db:unseal: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.backup unseal
scripts.access:login: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.access login
scripts.access:status: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.access status
scripts.access:revoke: uv run --project apps/api python -m researchchain.access revoke
